declarations.name: AuiOtpInput
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI OtpInput: `<aui-otp-input>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: Show dots instead of characters (PINs); the input becomes type=password.

inputs.name: uppercase
inputs.description: Alphanumeric only: convert letters to upper case.

inputs.name: groupSize
inputs.description: Visual group size (separators are presentation only).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation of a complete code.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: User edited the code (the code is not in the detail).

outputs.name: completed
outputs.description: The code became complete through user input (typing, paste, or autofill).

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Empty the code and focus the field (after a rejected code).

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now (marks the control submitted) and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); null clears it.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Move focus to the primary focusable element.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: One native <input> with <label for>; visual cells are aria-hidden presentation. Chosen over N single-character inputs: one-time-code autofill and password managers fill one field, paste/undo/selection stay native, screen readers hear one labelled field with a length hint instead of N unlabelled boxes, and fast typing never loses characters to focus changes.

limitations: Only ASCII letters and digits are accepted (after NFKC, so full-width digits work).
The active-cell highlight follows the caret on keyup, click, and selection; selection by pointer drag is not mirrored cell by cell.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
